trigger_prototype.expression: last(/HUAWEI OLT - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.huawei[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}])=0 and diff(/HUAWEI OLT - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.huawei[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}])=1 and count(/HUAWEI OLT - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.huawei[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_NAME}: Queda total de ONUs

trigger_prototype.description: 3 ou mais ONUs passaram a ter LOS como motivo de queda nos ultimos 15 minutos. Possivel rompimento de fibra na PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_NAME}.

trigger_prototype.expression: change(/HUAWEI OLT - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.huawei[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}])<-{$GPON_DROP_MIN} and last(/HUAWEI OLT - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.huawei[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}])>0 and count(/HUAWEI OLT - NETSTREAM/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.huawei[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],180s)>1
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_NAME}: Queda parcial de ONUs

trigger_prototype.expression: max(/HUAWEI OLT - NETSTREAM/netstream.uplink.status[{#SNMPINDEX}],#3)=2 and diff(/HUAWEI OLT - NETSTREAM/netstream.uplink.status[{#SNMPINDEX}])=1 and count(/HUAWEI OLT - NETSTREAM/netstream.uplink.status[{#SNMPINDEX}],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: Uplink {#IFDESC}: Link DOWN

trigger_prototype.expression: diff(/HUAWEI OLT - NETSTREAM/OltLinktState[{#OLTPORT}])=1 and last(/HUAWEI OLT - NETSTREAM/OltLinktState[{#OLTPORT}])=2 and count(/HUAWEI OLT - NETSTREAM/OltLinktState[{#OLTPORT}],180)>1
trigger_prototype.recovery_expression: diff(/HUAWEI OLT - NETSTREAM/OltLinktState[{#OLTPORT}])=1 and last(/HUAWEI OLT - NETSTREAM/OltLinktState[{#OLTPORT}])=1
trigger_prototype.name: {#OLTPORT}: {#IFALIAS}
